featured_techniques.technique: Client empowerment and transition-focused coaching (preparing clients to leave and own transformation)

sections.description: Bliss describes the value she offers to executive teams and CX leaders, foregrounding her hands-on, practitioner background and her direct involvement with clients.
sections.title: Coaching value and practitioner background

sections.description: She explains a distinctive approach: prepare clients to leave, so they own the changes, alter behaviors, and drive transformation after the engagement ends.
sections.title: Client empowerment and exit-driven transformation

summary: In this brief clip, Jeanne Bliss articulates a practitioner-focused approach to executive CX coaching. She emphasizes hands-on, lived-experience leadership in helping chief customer officers and CX leaders, asserting that she personally engages with clients. A defining thread is her provocative commitment to end-user independence: she aims to equip clients to continue driving change after she leaves, ensuring ownership, behavioral change, and sustained transformation rather than dependency on the coach.
title: Jeanne Bliss on Teaching You to Fish: Coaching for Client Ownership and Transformation
